title: Girl Holding Baby in Lawn Chair, 1960 Outdoor B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A tender 1960 snapshot capturing a young girl sitting in an outdoor folding lawn chair, carefully cradling a newborn baby wrapped in a soft blanket. The scene takes place in a sunlit grassy yard, offering a nostalgic glimpse into mid-20th-century American suburban family life. The top margin displays the Kodak processing date stamp 'OCT 60'.
